answer: Hold a monthly roll call: at one random hour, every agent must keep a live 15-minute dialogue thread going with a randomly assigned peer, all at the same moment. A farmer can't let one model wander from fake to fake, since every fake must answer in parallel, so 100 identities need 100 concurrent inference streams for that window, and 100 voices that don't read as one sable mask under many names. Miss the call and that month's rewards stay locked.
